items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: For nine years, Glenn excelled in the role of Suzanne Somer’s musical director.

ctx.x: Multi-instrumentalist Glenn Zottola has enjoyed a diverse career in music that includes collaborations with Bob Wilber, Benny Goodman, and Maxine Sullivan. For nine years, Glenn excelled in the role of Suzanne Somer’s musical director.
Glenn was interviewed on December 7, 2020 via Zoom by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
